prompts.natural_caption: Describe only what is visibly present in this image. Do not infer hidden details.
prompts.spatial_inspection: Describe visible objects and their spatial relationships. State UNKNOWN when a requested relationship is not visible. Do not infer hidden details.
prompts.targeted_architecture: Inspect this diagram as a neutral scene. Say whether a road, driveway, house, pool, neighbour building, roof, tree, or boundary is visibly present, and describe only visible spatial relations. Use UNKNOWN for anything not visible.

acceptance.threshold: Correct E-L relationships, no material hallucination, and materially better image-dependent spatial behavior than the 256M baseline.
